These publications introduced Zeffiro Interface, implemented methods that ship with it, or explicitly extend the software. Bibliographic records are taken from CrossRef and the official project references. Each entry links to its DOI and, where available, PubMed or PMC.

Introducing the interface

2019 · Neuroinformatics

Zeffiro User Interface for Electromagnetic Brain Imaging: a GPU Accelerated FEM Tool for Forward and Inverse Computations in Matlab

He, Q., Rezaei, A., & Pursiainen, S.

Neuroinformatics, 18(2), 237–250. doi:10.1007/s12021-019-09436-9

Original publication introducing the Zeffiro Interface code package.
